interpretation: annotation-ranking prediction; primary endpoint uses chem_score; no column is a chemical occupancy probability or a success rate
full_score: 0.0000 (v2 full model, secondary endpoint and detectability proxy)
deployed_form: single_lightgbm_binary_full_fit OR three_member_blend; declare before submission
pep_len: theoretical tryptic peptide length in residues
pep_mass: theoretical monoisotopic peptide mass in Da
pep_cys_count: number of Cys in the theoretical peptide
pep_detectable_any_missed_cleavage: TRUE if detectable allowing 1 or 2 missed cleavages; mandatory stratifier
